decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>The window(s) in the flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
</p><p>(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
</p><p>(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
</p><p>and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</p>

This permission shall have the effect of varying condition numbered 2 on approved application reference PL/0161/23 dated 14/12/2023The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp; CON 2- 01, CON 2- 02, Location Plan, PL-01, PL-02, PL-03, PL-04, Design and Access Statement (Dated: 19/05/2023); Reasonable Exception Statement (Dated: 23/05/2023), Supporting Statement.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building and on the approved plans.
description: Variation of conditions 2 (approved plans) and 3 (external surfaces) attached to planning permission P/1442/23 dated 12/07/2023 to allow for alternative materials and external alterations
